summary: Describes how a pseudowire can carry PPP or HDLC units over an MPLS network without terminating the PPP/HDLC protocol. Service providers can offer emulated HDLC or PPP link services over existing MPLS networks. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Instead of building a separate old-style line, the provider packs its traffic inside a modern network, as if the old line were still there.
